name: Netcompany
verdict: A Copenhagen-listed IT company whose only 5%+ holders are the founders' holding company, the Danish labour-market pension scheme ATP and Goldman Sachs.
note: Danish technology company. Joined as co-title sponsor of the cycling team in a five-year partnership from May 2026, the team racing in new kit as Netcompany INEOS from the 2026 Giro d'Italia (team announcement on its partner page).
